title: Getting started with bayesqm
text: run_bayes() fits model K range applies peak-plus-Sivula protocol: ELPD peak automated choice Sivula parsimony rule (Sivula et al. 2025) reported alongside diagnostic. real data: ΔELPD across K Sivula non-promotion band |ΔELPD| < 4. Triangle marks Sivula K, square marks ELPD peak (adopted K). ELPD peak always adopted K. Sivula diagnostic reported alongside parsimony check. run$case field labels relationship two: Sivula lands K peak, case agree; Sivula points smaller K peak, case gap; Sivula exceeds peak, case reversed (rare practice).
code: run <- run_bayes(qdata, K_max = 4, seed = 1,                  chains = 2, iter = 1500, warmup = 800) run <- demo_run(K_max = 5, k_peak = 3, k_sivula = 1, case = "gap") run #> Bayesian Q-methodology: multi-K comparison #>   K range:      1..5 #>   ELPD peak:    K = 3  (automated adoption) #>   Sivula rule:  K = 1  (parsimony diagnostic) #>   Case:         gap  (ELPD peak > Sivula (weak discrimination between adjacent models)) #>  #> LOO comparison: #>  K    elpd   se delta_elpd se_delta ratio #>  1 -180.09 8.00                           #>  2 -170.91 7.25      -9.18     3.00  3.06 #>  3 -165.42 6.50      -5.49     3.00  1.83 #>  4 -170.20 5.75       4.78     3.00  1.59 #>  5 -179.61 5.00       9.41     3.00  3.14 #>  #> Case 'gap': k_peak is adopted; Sivula is reported as a parsimony diagnostic only. make_elpd_diff(run)

what: Bayesian Q Methodology: Probabilistic Factor Analysis
title: Bayesian Q Methodology: Probabilistic Factor Analysis
text: Bayesian Q methodology: probabilistic factor analysis study subjective opinions. bayesqm first fully Bayesian framework Q-methodology factor analysis. Since Stephenson (1935), Q analysis relied frequentist factor extraction standard error rule Brown (1980), returns participant--factor assignments binary flagged / unflagged decisions offers measure uncertainty . bayesqm replaces posterior credible intervals every loading, probabilistic factor membership P(dominant_i = k | Y) makes cross-loading visible quantifiable, principled K-selection protocol built element-wise PSIS-LOO. model uses Student-t likelihood robustness idiosyncratic Q-sorts resolves rotational, sign, label-permutation ambiguity MatchAlign post-processing Poworoznek et al. (2025). Posterior sampling via Stan (cmdstanr rstan).

title: Bayesian Q Methodology: Probabilistic Factor Analysis
text: Q-sort dataset, bayesqm returns four things classical Q analysis : continuous measure assignment certainty. Probabilistic factor membership, P(dominant_i = k | Y), making cross-loading visible quantifiable rather forcing participant onto single factor. surfacing gap informative strongly data discriminate adjacent models. Posterior distinguishing consensus statements, reporting P(D_j > delta | Y) P(D_j < delta | Y) posterior explicit viewpoint-divergence measure rather classical significance verdict.

title: Bayesian Q Methodology: Probabilistic Factor Analysis
text: run_bayes() fits model K = 1..K_max reports two summaries: ELPD peak: argmax expected log pointwise predictive density via element-wise PSIS-LOO (Vehtari, Gelman, & Gabry, 2017). Sivula parsimony diagnostic (Sivula et al., 2025): sequential rule accepts complex K ΔELPD > 4 |ΔELPD| / SE(Δ) > 2. $case field labels relationship agree, gap, reversed. ELPD peak always adopted K; case label indicates confidently data discriminate adjacent models, gap two diagnostic information.

title: Bayesian Q Methodology: Probabilistic Factor Analysis
text: Rather dichotomizing loading flagged unflagged, bayesqm reports posterior probability factor k participant ’s dominant factor, P(dominant_i = k | Y). compute_dominant_sign() adds posterior probability dominant loading positive, negative exemplars (viewpoint held opposition) stay distinct. classify_membership() turns probabilities descriptive Strong / Moderate / Weak tier: Distinguishing consensus statements come posterior explicit viewpoint-divergence measure D_j, probabilities P(D_j > delta | Y) P(D_j < delta | Y) implies. delta computed default Bayesian reliability-adjusted critical difference (critical_delta()); suggest_delta() (one forced-distribution category) alternative:
code: compute_dominant_prob(fit$Lambda_draws) compute_dominant_sign(fit$Lambda_draws) classify_membership(fit$Lambda_draws) plot_membership(fit) d <- critical_delta(fit$Lambda_draws)   # default separation (computed) compute_divergence(fit$F_draws, delta = d) plot_dist_cons(fit)                 # uses the fit's stored divergence summary

title: Bayesian Q Methodology: Probabilistic Factor Analysis
text: bayesqm_fit deliberately mirrors slot names qmethod package (Zabala, 2015): $dataset, $loa, $zsc, $zsc_n, $f_char, $qdc, $flagged. $qdc Bayesian divergence table: per-viewpoint grid position z-score 95% CrI, D_j 95% CrI, pi_D, pi_C, classical significance-label vocabulary. what: Probabilistic factor-membership and divergence summaries — bayesqm-membership
title: Probabilistic factor-membership and divergence summaries — bayesqm-membership
text: Posterior summaries factor membership statement interpretation, computed entirely posterior draws: compute_threshold_prob() returns N x K posterior probability |lambda_ik| > threshold, .e. Bayesian version Brown (1980) flagging rule. compute_dominant_prob() returns N x K posterior probability factor k dominant factor participant . compute_dominant_sign() returns length-N posterior probability dominant loading positive; participants probability 0.5 negative exemplars. compute_divergence() returns posterior viewpoint divergence D_j every statement, together distinguishing consensus probabilities implies. classify_membership() turns dominant probabilities per-participant descriptive tier (Strong / Moderate / Weak).

title: Probabilistic factor-membership and divergence summaries — bayesqm-membership
code: compute_threshold_prob(Lambda_draws, threshold)  compute_dominant_prob(Lambda_draws)  compute_dominant_sign(Lambda_draws)  compute_divergence(F_draws, delta = NULL, delta_grid = NULL)  classify_membership(Lambda_draws, strong = 0.8, moderate = 0.6)

title: Probabilistic factor-membership and divergence summaries — bayesqm-membership
text: Lambda_draws Array shape [T, N, K] aligned loading draws. threshold Numeric threshold; natural default 1.96 / sqrt(J) Brown rule. F_draws Array shape [T, J, K] aligned factor-score draws. delta Substantive separation distinguishing consensus probabilities. fit pipeline supplies default, reliability-adjusted critical difference critical_delta(); suggest_delta() alternative. NULL D_j posterior (median, 95% CrI, g_jk) still returned distinguishing/consensus probabilities NA. delta_grid Optional numeric vector delta values sensitivity sweep. strong, moderate Tier cutoffs max P(dominant) (defaults 0.80 0.60).

title: Probabilistic factor-membership and divergence summaries — bayesqm-membership
text: compute_threshold_prob() compute_dominant_prob() return N x K matrices. compute_dominant_sign() returns length-N named vector. compute_divergence() returns list (see Details). classify_membership() returns data frame.

title: Probabilistic factor-membership and divergence summaries — bayesqm-membership
text: statement j standardized viewpoint scores f_{j1}, ..., f_{jK}, divergence estimand mean absolute pairwise difference D_j = 2 / (K (K - 1)) * sum_{k < l} |f_jk - f_jl|. mean used rather maximum, order statistic K (K - 1) / 2 contrasts inflated posterior diffuse. compute_divergence() reports posterior median central 95% credible interval D_j, pi_D = P(D_j > delta | Y) (distinguishing) pi_C = P(D_j < delta | Y) = 1 - pi_D (consensus), per-viewpoint departure g_jk = f_jk - mean_{l != k} f_jl dominant viewpoint, sign, P(|g_jk| > delta | Y). probabilities reported quantities; fixed probability cutoff defines distinguishing consensus statement.

what: Bayesian reliability-adjusted critical difference (default delta) — critical_delta
title: Bayesian reliability-adjusted critical difference (default delta) — critical_delta
text: default separation distinguishing consensus probabilities: Bayesian reliability-adjusted critical difference (Brown 1980; Zabala & Pascual 2016). p_f number participants whose posterior dominant factor f, r_f = p_f r0 / (1 + (p_f - 1) r0) SE_f = sqrt(1 - r_f), delta = z * mean_{k < l} sqrt(SE_k^2 + SE_l^2). reliability stable population reliability design, posterior estimation spread.

title: Read Q-sort data from file — read_qsort
code: read_qsort(file, format = "auto", ...)  read_qsort_csv(   file,   orientation = c("auto", "statements_rows", "participants_rows"),   id_col = c("auto", "first", "none"),   statements = NULL,   distribution = NULL,   ... )  read_qsort_excel(   file,   sheet = 1,   orientation = c("auto", "statements_rows", "participants_rows"),   id_col = c("auto", "first", "none"),   statements = NULL,   distribution = NULL,   ... )  read_pqmethod(file, statements_file = NULL)  read_kenq(file, format = c("auto", "json", "csv"))  read_kenq_excel(file)  read_kade_zip(file)  read_easyhtml_firebase(file)  read_statements(file, column = 1, id_column = NULL)

title: Read Q-sort data from file — read_qsort
text: file Path data file. format read_qsort(), "auto" (default) one "csv", "excel", "pqmethod", "kenq", "kenq_excel", "kade", "easyhtml_firebase". read_kenq(), one "auto", "json", "csv". ... Passed underlying reader. orientation generic CSV/Excel: "auto", "statements_rows", "participants_rows". id_col generic CSV/Excel: "auto", "first", "none". statements, distribution Optional overrides passed qsort_data(). sheet Excel sheet name index (default 1). statements_file PQMethod, optional companion statements file. column, id_column read_statements(): column index name.

title: Read Q-sort data from file — read_qsort
text: qsort_data object, except read_statements() returns named character vector.

title: Tucker's congruence and orthogonal Procrustes rotation — tucker_congruence
text: Linear-algebra utilities shared MatchAlign recovery assessments. tucker_congruence(x, y) computes sum(x*y) / sqrt(sum(x^2) * sum(y^2)). procrustes_rotation(X, Target) finds orthogonal R minimising ||X R - Target||_F returns X %*% R R attached attribute "rotation".
